about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I am a mid-level Full-Stack Developer with over 4 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining web applications across multiple domains including ERP, e-commerce, transportation, and healthcare. I've contributed to both freelance and in-house projects, gaining deep technical knowledge in .NET technologies, clean architecture, and modern development practices. Known for being self-taught and highly driven, I take pride in writing clean, scalable code, integrating third-party services, and solving complex backend challenges.
highlights: Strong experience with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and MediatR
Built systems for ERP, e-commerce, transportation, and healthcare
Hands-on experience with SQL Server, EF Core, Dapper, and T-SQL
Integrated third-party services (Paymob, Stripe, Fawry, WhatsApp APIs, AI)
Experienced in mentoring junior developers and leading code reviews

experience.description: Developed an enterprise HR Management System using .NET 8 and Clean Architecture, with a focus on scalable, maintainable backend services.
responsibilities: Implemented the CQRS pattern with MediatR to separate commands and queries
Built and maintained RESTful APIs for HR modules, ensuring scalability and maintainability
Implemented validation using FluentValidation and object mapping using AutoMapper
Wrote unit tests using xUnit and Moq, and maintained API documentation
Supported multi-tenancy, localization, and role-based business workflows
Participated in code reviews, bug fixing, and performance optimization
Worked in an Agile/Scrum environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams

experience.description: Led the end-to-end development and ongoing improvement of a robust ERP system using the ASP.NET MVC framework, managing both backend logic and frontend functionality.
responsibilities: Partnered with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, translating business needs into scalable technical solutions
Architected and implemented core system modules while enforcing clean architecture principles
Integrated diverse third-party services including AI chatbots, WhatsApp APIs, email providers, and the Salla Platform
Refactored and optimized legacy codebases to boost performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability
Mentored junior developers through technical guidance and contributed to project planning

experience.description: Developed and maintained backend systems across diverse domains including medical consultations, social networking, e-commerce, transportation management, and vehicle maintenance.
responsibilities: Collaborated with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, efficient technical solutions
Integrated multiple third-party services including Fawry, Paymob, Stripe, Fawaterk, WhatsApp APIs, and email providers
Refactored and modernized legacy codebases (MVC5), improving reliability and reducing technical debt
Built frontend features with jQuery and Bootstrap while optimizing backend performance
Contributed to code reviews and solution design discussions across cross-functional teams
